title: 1364. Bitwise Operations on Two Integers
description:
ints & Solutions

. 
Bitwise Operations on Two Integers
10
Easy
Problem Statement:
Create a program that calculates the bitwise AND, OR, XOR, and NOT operations on two integers provided by the user. 
Input Description:
The program should read two integers.
Two integers separated by a space. 
Output Description:
The program should compute and display the results of the bitwise AND, OR, XOR, and NOT operations.
Four lines, each representing the result of bitwise AND, OR, XOR, and NOT operations respectively. 
Sample Input:
10 4 
Sample Output:
Bitwise AND: 0
Bitwise OR: 14
Bitwise XOR: 14
Bitwise NOT (first number): -11
